title: Drizzle ORM schema and migration
intent: The layer above the driver: an ORM with its own code generation and migration tooling. Passing the driver and failing the ORM is a common and specific pattern worth naming.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Drizzle ORM (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Apply the schema and query through the ORM

knownLimits: Depends on fixture 19's driver path; if 19 is incompatible, this fixture reports the same cause rather than a second independent failure.
